Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in Step 3 by incorrectly stating that Frederick I Barbarossa was born in Haguenau, Alsace (now in France). Historical records confirm that Frederick I Barbarossa was born in Waiblingen, which is in modern-day Germany. This incorrect birthplace led the Planner to erroneously conclude his nationality is French based on modern geographical boundaries, when his actual nationality is German.
